# Utilities

Utilities for working with phones, firmware, and mobile files.

## Programs

- **[Java Midlet Installer](./java-midlet-installer.md)**<br/>
  Install J2ME applications and games from JAR/JAD pairs to BenQ-Siemens phones via USB.
- **[SXG75 Filename Cutter](./sxg75-filename-cutter.md)**<br/>
  Prepare media file names for the Siemens SXG75 by limiting length and removing unsupported characters.
- **[WSFF](./wsff.md)**<br/>
  A program for analyzing and unpacking Siemens WinSwup service firmware.
